author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಠಕ್ಕತನವಿರೆ ನಿನಗೆ ಆಕ್ಷಣದಿ ಸುಖವುಂಟು
ಕಕ್ಕುವೆಯೊ ಎಲ್ಲವನು ಕಡೆಗೊಂದು ದಿವಸ
ಸೊಕ್ಕುಜೊತೆಗೂಡಿರಲು ನಿಶ್ಚಯವೆ ಅವನತಿಯು
ಸಿಕ್ಕುಗಳ ತೊರೆದು ನಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you are a cheat, you may enjoy it for the moment;
one day you will have to cough it all up;
when arrogance comes along with it, downfall is certain;
drop the tangles and laugh, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Deceit brings short-lived pleasure, but it all comes back to us in the end, and arrogance on top of it makes the fall certain. Let go of such knots and live lightly.
